body: ubgo/auth is public at github.com/ubgo/auth since 2026-10-14 (owner's decision; history replaced by one fresh commit). GitHub Actions runs task check and the Postgres/MySQL suites on demand only since 2026-10-24 (task ci, task ci:status; no push or PR trigger); locally only the touched package's tests run. private notes stay out of the repo and are never tracked.
